text:
As we look ahead to the next round across Europe's top leagues, heavy favorites dominate the board, highlighted by a monumental Clasico where the model gives Barcelona a 68.8% chance of victory over Real Madrid. With market odds unavailable for upcoming fixtures, the focus turns to where the model sees the strongest probabilities and how it handled recent results across the continent.

For the upcoming slate, the model projects several overwhelmingly strong favourites worth keeping an eye on. Inter Milan leads all teams with an 83.9% home win chance against Fiorentina, Atletico Madrid holds a 79.8% chance against La Coruna, and Juventus carries a 79.5% away probability at Lecce.

Looking back at the latest played round, predictable home wins coexisted with massive upsets. In the Premier League, the model nailed Manchester City's victory with a 79.9% expectation, but took a hit on Chelsea's 2-0 win at Everton where the model had favoured the hosts at 45.1%. Over in Germany, Bayern Munich's 6-1 statement win over Leipzig was an easy call at an 81.0% win probability, though Elversberg's 4-3 thriller over Augsburg proved a major surprise against a 63.9% expected away win.

Serie A proved particularly chaotic for both the model and bookmakers. Venezia's 1-0 upset of Napoli was the weekend's biggest miss, coming against a 72.9% expected away win chance, while Lazio's 3-0 win at Juventus also defied the model's 56.2% home projection. Conversely, Ligue 1 provided smooth sailing for the model, which edged out bookmakers on log loss accuracy thanks to confident calls like Lens winning at Troyes with a 67.6% probability.
